description:
The koine HALF of KGP §4.1's round-trip gate: closing it by READING the downstream evidence, which is the step that was skipped last time.

UNPARKED 2026-08-28 on its own stated condition — 'unpark only to author the agora-side tasklist from it'. That tasklist now exists as `agora:84-kgp-projection-reader-and-roundtrip`, authored from this record, and this one depends on it.

WHAT CHANGED IN THIS RECORD. It was a cross-repo MARKER carrying agora's implementation stories while sitting in koine's tree with `project: agora`. chief resolves the repo from where it is invoked (`REPO="$CHIEF_PROJECT"` in driver.sh) and NOT from the `project` field — `crossRepo` is a lint escape hatch for criteria, not a dispatch mechanism — so running it here would have put an agent in a koine worktree and asked it to write `knowledge/src/`, which lives in agora. Its own last criterion forbade exactly that. The implementation stories moved to `agora:84` verbatim in substance; what remains here is the work that is genuinely koine's.

THE NUMBER AND SLUG ARE LOAD-BEARING. `specs/grounding-pack.md` §4.1 names `87-kgp-projection-reader-and-roundtrip` as the owner of the open remainder in four places, and `83-promote-kgp` recorded that naming. Do not renumber.

WHY THIS IS NOT A RUBBER STAMP. KGP 0.5.2 sits at Candidate on one gate. On 2026-08-22 koine retired its tracking marker on the strength of a downstream tasklist whose stories all read `passes: true`; `docs/reference/kgp-projection-gate-verification.md` is the record of checking that claim and finding G2, G3 and G4 unmet — the round trip had never been written. THIS TASKLIST MUST NOT REPEAT THAT. It closes the gate by reading the artifact and re-running the obligations against it, and it moves the status only if they are actually met.

userStories.title: The verdict is re-taken against the delivered artifact, obligation by obligation
userStories.notes: VERDICT: gate MET — G1, G2, G3, G4 all satisfied at agora af5b7dd3a1201eff70067f45e7824614a81769ac (merge of chief/84, 2026-08-28); agora main f48f9e0 is a retire commit only and `git diff af5b7dd HEAD -- knowledge/ Makefile` is EMPTY, so the tree read is the tree at main. Derived from RUNNING and PERTURBING, never from a passes flag. RUNS: `make check-knowledge` (eslint + tsc + vitest) GREEN — 8 files, 152 passed, 0 failed (projection.test.ts 25, roundtrip.test.ts 43, evidence.test.ts 12); `node knowledge/src/evidence.ts --check` EXIT 0, artifact current at sha256-27fd7839fe0b800020db9d77cad7f2076083d5d4c0ea251af03d2288d27b4edb. Only --check was used — the writing regenerate would edit agora. MY OWN MUTATIONS (the G3 criterion): 8 perturbations inside §3.1 hashed set — RDF-star x6 (object literal 3->4, subject entity id, predicate cine:reads->cine:shows, named graph/world, object datatype, kgp:claimId rewritten to a well-formed hash), PROV x1, JSON-LD x1 — ALL refused ProjectionError/claim-id-mismatch; untouched controls read clean in all three encodings. FILES: projection.ts 1032 (+861/-52, now emitter AND readProjection), roundtrip.ts 574 new, evidence.ts 430 new, projection.test.ts 420, roundtrip.test.ts 297 new, evidence.test.ts 169 new, pack.ts +100/-4, index.ts +17, evidence artifact 1 line, Makefile +11. ARTIFACT: 4 packs / 3 encodings / 12 round trips / 39 claims projected / 39 ids re-derived / 42 prov records / 3 merged / 3 omitted-with-report / 0 local-only; byte_identical true 12 of 12. CLOSED SINCE 2026-08-26: reader exists and is exported; rule 2 derives from the graph under the registry signature (not from carried hash_input); OWL-Time in the emitter (2 ProperInterval / 2 hasTime / 3 inXSDDateTimeStamp per encoding, counted off the graph); arity>2 omitted WITH a report, 1 of 2 claims recovered, no whole-pack abort; unrecognised annotation reported with claim/term/value; §3.3 convergence (2 producers, 1 id, both prov retained) and §7 axes per encoding; "local-only" absent as a substring from all three encodings. RECORDED AS NOT-OVER-READ (neither an unmet obligation): artifact ids_rederived re-hashes hash_input and corroborates the strong check rather than being it; every corpus pack has entities: 0, so §2 entity snapshots round-trip only in projection.test.ts fixture. Doc keeps its Status/Updated/Owner banner + binds-no-clause disclaimer; §6 retains the superseded 2026-08-26 reading. CHECKS: .chief/verify.sh --run green — guard-doc-integrity OK (1333 links, all 3 status tables match headers), guard-doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main.
acceptanceCriteria: `docs/reference/kgp-projection-gate-verification.md` §2 and §3 are re-taken against agora's delivered artifact at a NAMED sha, the same way the 2026-08-26 reading was: files, line counts, what each obligation's evidence actually is.

Each of G1, G2, G3 and G4 gets a verdict derived from RUNNING or READING the artifact — not from `agora:84`'s `passes` flags. The `passes` flag is the thing this document exists to distrust; citing it as evidence would reproduce the 2026-08-22 retire exactly.

The mutation tests are the specific thing checked for G3: confirm a perturbed projection actually FAILS, because a rule-2 checker that has only seen conformant input proves nothing. If the artifact's regenerate command is one command, run it.
The document keeps its `Status · Updated · Owner` banner and its standing disclaimer that it binds no clause. It records a verification, not a contract.
An obligation that is still unmet is recorded as unmet, with what is missing. A partial close is a legitimate outcome of this story and must not be rounded up.

userStories.title: The status moves only if the gate is met, and the spec says which
userStories.notes: PROMOTED: specs/grounding-pack.md KGP 0.5.2 Candidate -> ratified, header line 4 + §4.1 gate paragraph + a dated changelog entry naming agora af5b7dd3a1201eff70067f45e7824614a81769ac as the sha the promotion rests on. Condition satisfied: US-1's verdict was gate MET on all four obligations (G1-G4), taken by running and perturbing the artifact, so the IF-AND-ONLY-IF branch fired and the UNMET branch did not. BYTE-STABILITY CONFIRMED, not asserted: `git show HEAD:` vs the working copy, section by section — §3 Normalization block 9394 bytes IDENTICAL, §4/§4.1 up to the gate paragraph (mapping + annotation-vocabulary tables) 12003 bytes IDENTICAL, §5 through §9 10093 bytes IDENTICAL, changelog tail below the new entry IDENTICAL. `git diff -U0` shows exactly three hunks: line 4 (status/date), 371-433 (the gate paragraph), 602+ (the new changelog entry). §1 and §2 untouched. No claim id moves. OWNER REPOINTED: §4.1 no longer names 87-kgp-projection-reader-and-roundtrip or 64-kgp-projection-roundtrip-fixture as owning an open remainder — it states it has none. NO AGORA FILE EDITED: git status lists 10 files, all koine, all in this worktree. MIRRORS: the three guard-checked tables (README.md, specs/README.md, ECOSYSTEM.md) now read `0.5.2 · ✅ ratified`; the fourth, CLAUDE.md's unchecked Current state prose, updated by hand; plus ROADMAP.md (status line 0-of-6 -> 1-of-6, Phase 1 KGP row ✅, Phase F5 fixture row ✅, two stale drift notes closed), docs/reference/promotability.md (banner date, intro, KGP row, Cheapest-first #1), scenarios/README.md, docs/reference/federation-fold-dispositions.md, and the §4 done-marker in docs/reference/kgp-projection-gate-verification.md. CHECKS GREEN: check-doc-integrity 56 files / 1339 links, all 3 status tables match their headers, grounding-pack 0.5.2 ratified; check-schemas OK; check-registry OK; check-tasklist-categories OK; .chief/verify.sh --run green — guard-doc-integrity OK, guard-doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main, guard-categories OK, verify-selftest 30 passed 0 failed.
acceptanceCriteria: IF AND ONLY IF G1–G4 are all met per US-1: `specs/grounding-pack.md` moves from **Candidate** to **ratified** — the banner, §4.1's gate paragraph, and a changelog entry naming the agora sha the promotion rests on.

IF ANY OBLIGATION IS UNMET: the status does NOT move, §4.1 is updated to state the narrowed remainder and who owns it, and this tasklist says so plainly. A gate that promotes on a partial close is not a gate — and the whole point of this record is that it was retired once on a claim that had not been checked.

§4.1's owner reference is repointed from this tasklist to whatever now owns any remainder, or removed if nothing remains. A spec citing a completed tasklist as the owner of open work is a stale pointer of the kind that started this.

Clause text outside the gate paragraph is byte-unchanged and no claim id moves. Confirm it — §3, §3.1, §3.3, the §4.1 mapping tables, §5, §6 and §7 have been held byte-stable across every 0.5.x editorial pass and this is not the one that breaks that.
No agora file is edited by this tasklist. Evidence flows koine-ward by citation, per ADR-0001.
